gallery.filename: Borough Hall & Court St (NYC subway stations).png
gallery.title: File:Borough Hall & Court St (NYC subway stations).png
gallery.artist: Where as a Rose I will Wake
gallery.description: Metrically accurate station map showing tracks, platforms, mezzanines, stairs, elevators, escalators, exits, ticket machines, gates, benches, and trashcans (state September 2024 with construction in progress). Tens of hours of 3D scanning the station with my iPhone's LiDAR using rtabmap, puzzling together the scans in Blender, and tracing the entire station complex from these scans in Blender, picking fun materials and experimenting with different perspectives, and rendering the final views before composing them and adding labels in Affinity Designer 2.

gallery.title: File:Atlantic (Terminal,Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr) (NYC (LIRR,subway) station).png
gallery.artist: Where as a Rose I will Wake
gallery.description: Metrically accurate station map of Atlantic Terminal / Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr, showing tracks, platforms, mezzanines, stairs, elevators, escalators, exits, ticket machines (subway and LIRR), gates, benches, restrooms, and trashcans (state October 2024 with construction in progress). For the first time less than 10 hours of 3D scanning the station with my iPhone's LiDAR using rtabmap, but plenty more, puzzling together the scans in Blender, and tracing the entire station complex from these scans in Blender, picking fun materials and experimenting with different perspectives, and rendering the final views before composing them and adding labels in Affinity Designer 2.

gallery.filename: Court Sq–23 St (NYC subway station map).png
gallery.title: File:Court Sq–23 St (NYC subway station map).png
gallery.artist: Where as a Rose I will Wake
gallery.description: Metrically accurate station map of Court Sq–23 St, showing platforms, mezzanines, stairs, elevators, escalators, exits, ticket machines (MetroCard and OMNY), gates, benches, and trashcans (state Dec 31, 2024 with construction in progress). A small and quick project: 3D scanning the station with my iPhone's LiDAR using rtabmap, puzzling together the scans in Blender, and tracing the entire station complex from these scans in Blender, picking fun materials and experimenting with different perspectives, and rendering the final views before composing them and adding labels in Affinity Designer 2.
